text.content:
The totems most common among Ghanaian and Ivory Coast shamans; Caribbean shamans of African descent may follow them too. Any of them may also conjure ancestor spirits (see Ancestor Spirits).

Spell and conjuring dice are automated when the totem is chosen on the Magic tab. "Spirits of the Sky" means mist and storm spirits (the system's wind spirits too). The system has no jungle domain, so jungle-spirit bonuses, Banishing dice, conditional bonuses and every disadvantage are applied by hand. Cyberpirates p.152.

Aggressive, capricious and cunning, Hyena serves herself first, angers fast and stands her ground against bigger rivals — even lions, over a kill.

Favored environment: Savannah

Advantages: +2 dice for combat spells, +2 dice to Banishing.

Disadvantages: −1 die for health spells. A Willpower (4) Test to do anything that brings her no benefit.

In Foundry: pick Agwengwere (Hyena) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 combat; −1 health; conjuring —. By hand: +2 Banishing; the Willpower test.

Cyberpirates p.152.

Spider in her African aspect: creator, destroyer and trickster. She waits and plots, and her web is delicate but strong; she strikes fast and without remorse.

Favored environment: Quiet, dark places where few ever look

Advantages: +1 die for illusion and manipulation spells; +1 die for conjuring.

Disadvantages: +2 TN for Magic Tests in open areas; +1 TN when the shaman has no time to think a situation through (gamemaster's call).

In Foundry: pick Anansi (Spider) as the totem. Automated: spells +1 illusion, +1 manipulation; conjuring —. By hand: the +1 conjuring die (the book doesn't name a spirit type); both disadvantages.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Bat is a traveller and restless seeker with far-reaching goals, at home anywhere and uneasy standing still.

Favored environment: Anywhere

Advantages: +2 dice for detection and manipulation spells; +1 die for conjuring Spirits of the Sky.

Disadvantages: +2 to all magical TNs in direct sunlight. Distracted and irritable after a week in one place.

In Foundry: pick Asenna (Bat) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 detection, +2 manipulation; conjuring +1 wind, +1 mist, +1 storm. By hand: both disadvantages.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Leopard has stamina and great bursts of speed: aggressive, vicious when cornered, reclusive and nocturnal, trusting keen senses over intellect — so appearances can fool him.

Favored environment: Forest and savannah

Advantages: +2 dice for combat and health spells; +2 dice for conjuring nature spirits during hours of darkness.

Disadvantages: −1 die on Spell Resistance Tests against illusions. Must defend family from harm, to the death if need be (no test to avoid it).

In Foundry: pick Awoba (Leopard) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 combat, +2 health; conjuring —. By hand: the +2 conjuring at night; both disadvantages.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Dove is a peaceful messenger and mediator who helps others to the point of martyrdom, and prides herself on staying aware of everything around her.

Favored environment: Forests and savannah

Advantages: +2 dice for health spells, +1 die for detection spells, +1 die for conjuring Spirits of the Sky.

Disadvantages: Cannot cast combat spells. A successful Willpower (4) Test to deliberately kill a metahuman.

In Foundry: pick Danwane (Dove) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 health, +1 detection; conjuring +1 wind, +1 mist, +1 storm. By hand: the combat-spell ban (the system won't stop the cast); the Willpower test.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Like Anlo (Shark), Crocodile is a relentless, savage hunter with no fixed home who knows the secrets of the sea.

Favored environment: On or by the sea and rivers

Advantages: +2 dice for combat spells; +1 die for illusion spells; +2 dice for conjuring sea and river spirits.

Disadvantages: Wounded in combat, or after a kill: a Willpower Test, TN 3 modified by injury. On 2 or fewer successes the shaman goes berserk for up to 3 turns (minus the successes), attacking the nearest living target with their most powerful weapon or spell.

In Foundry: pick Nau (Crocodile) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 combat, +1 illusion; conjuring +2 sea, +2 river. By hand: the berserk test.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Python is huge, slow and ponderous — no match for fast events — but immensely strong, quick to recover, merciless once on top, and able to dominate others by will. Peaceful, but unforgiving if provoked.

Favored environment: Jungle

Advantages: +2 dice for health and manipulation spells; +2 dice for conjuring jungle spirits.

Disadvantages: To stop fighting or any ongoing activity: a successful Willpower (6) Test.

In Foundry: pick Onini (Python) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 health, +2 manipulation; conjuring —. By hand: +2 jungle spirits (no jungle domain in the system); the Willpower test.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Like Jaguar, Cheetah is a skilled hunter and warrior who takes the most direct route, and a jack of many trades rarely at a loss.

Favored environment: Savannah

Advantages: +2 dice for combat spells; +2 dice for conjuring savannah (prairie) spirits.

Disadvantages: −1 die for health spells. Natural Reaction of at least 4. Proud of her competence; hates admitting she can't do something.

In Foundry: pick Osebo (Cheetah) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 combat; −1 health; conjuring +2 prairie. By hand: the Reaction minimum (check at creation); the roleplaying.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Cobra is a skilled, stealthy hunter who hypnotizes prey to draw it close; slow to decide, uncompromising, and dislikes surprises.

Favored environment: Jungle

Advantages: +2 dice for combat and illusion spells; +1 die for conjuring jungle spirits.

Disadvantages: Can't fight to stun: either abstains or goes for the kill. Slow when startled: surprised, +1 to all TNs for the whole combat.

In Foundry: pick Owoh (Cobra) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 combat, +2 illusion; conjuring —. By hand: +1 jungle spirits (no jungle domain in the system); both disadvantages.

Cyberpirates p.153.

Like Rat, Jackal is a stealthy, selfish thief and a reluctant warrior who would rather run — but also mischievous, playful and unconventional.

Favored environment: Savannah

Advantages: +2 dice for detection and illusion spells; +2 dice for conjuring savannah (prairie) spirits.

Disadvantages: −1 die for all combat spells.

In Foundry: pick Sase (Jackal) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 detection, +2 illusion; −1 combat; conjuring +2 prairie.

Cyberpirates p.154.

Parrot is a colorful, wisecracking show-off: brightest plumage, loudest voice, showiest magic, and always the center of attention.

Favored environment: Jungle

Advantages: +2 dice for illusion spells; +2 dice for conjuring jungle spirits.

Disadvantages: +1 to magical TNs without an appreciative audience.

In Foundry: pick Wurega (Parrot) as the totem. Automated: spells +2 illusion; conjuring —. By hand: +2 jungle spirits (no jungle domain in the system); the audience modifier.

Cyberpirates p.154.

Local West African names for standard totems — use the standard totem (Awakenings p.151–155):

Local nameUse
Agona (Crow)Raven
Anlo (Shark)Shark
Gbwegen (Lion)Lion
Gwobeag (Dog)Dog
Kpwire (Mouse)Gecko
Oyoko (Falcon)Eagle
Weme (Deer/Antelope)Horse

Raven, Shark, Lion, Dog and Eagle are in the core system's totem list. Gecko and Horse are not: until a module adds them, run them by hand. Cyberpirates p.154.
